[[Pongmei Valley]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y }} {{Quotation|game|A safe haven for travelers, Tanglewood Copse lies nestled between the outer edges of the southern [[Kaineng City]] and the harsh, towering [[Qinkaishi Mountains]]. According to legend, the [[Kaineng Tah|first emperor]] stopped to camp here for the night during his inaugural tour of the [[Echovald Forest]]. It is now a site of pilgrimage for devotees of traditional [[Cantha]]n ancestor worship.}} [[Tanglewood Copse]] lies on the northern edge of the Echovald Forest, and is the outpost one must pass to get there. ==Getting there== [[The Count's Daughter]] [[primary quest]] leads characters here after completion of the [[Tahnnakai Temple]] mission, but the outpost can be accessed any time after completion of [[Nahpui Quarter]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{w}} 20 [[Kurzick Guard]]s *{{w}} 20 [[Luxon Guard]]s *{{x}} 20 [[Fireworks Master]] *{{x}} 20 [[Kurzick Merchant]] *{{x}} 10 [[Kurzick Gatekeeper]] ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Benman]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== *{{w}} 20 [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} 20 [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} 20 [[Jamei]] (Healer) *{{n}} 20 [[Eve]] (Cultist) *{{me}} 20 [[Lo Sha]] (Illusion) *{{e}} 20 [[Cynn]] (Mage) *{{a}} 20 [[Nika]] (Deadly) *{{rt}} 20 [[Professor Gai]] (Spirit) {{anomaly| This outpost does not have a signpost leading to [[Arborstone (explorable area)]].}} {{Towns and outposts in the Echovald Forest}}
